# cgltf (vendored)

`cgltf.h` v1.14 from https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf (tag v1.14), unmodified. License: MIT
(see `LICENSE`). Built only through `src/modassets_libs.c`, used by `src/modassets_own.c` to read
the glTF 2.0 binary (`.glb`) meshes a mod brings in its `own/` folder (docs/MODDING.md "Your own
assets").
